name: Kansas veterans: state field offices for claims help
description: Free help with VA claims, appeals, pension and survivor benefits from Kansas Office of Veterans Services veteran service representatives. Kansas has no county veterans offices: 16 state field offices, from Colby to Kansas City, each serve a set of counties, and most hold monthly itinerant hours in nearby towns.
next_step: Choose your county for its field office and itinerant schedule, and call the office to schedule an appointment. The department’s toll-free line is 800-513-7731.
constraints: Itinerant visits and appointments are subject to change; call before you go.
The Winfield office’s representative position is vacant; its counties are asked to call the eastern-region supervisor.

name: Kansas Aging and Disability Resource Center
organization: Kansas Department for Aging and Disability Services, Aging and Disability Resource Center (ADRC)
description: Kansas’s Aging and Disability Resource Center is a statewide call center that helps older adults, people with disabilities and caregivers find long-term care options and in-home and community services, and can complete the assessment needed before nursing facility admission. Local Area Agencies on Aging serve as its regional offices. Military service is not required.
next_step: Call 855-200-2372 (855-200-ADRC), Monday–Friday 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; you can leave a message after hours. Or choose a county above for its Area Agency on Aging.
constraints: Each program has its own eligibility and waitlist.

name: Medicare counseling (SHICK) for Kansas
organization: Kansas Department for Aging and Disability Services, Senior Health Insurance Counseling for Kansas (SHICK)
description: Free Medicare counseling from Senior Health Insurance Counseling for Kansas, the state’s health insurance assistance program. Trained community volunteers, who do not work for any insurance company, answer questions about Medicare plans, enrollment, costs and help paying for Medicare.
next_step: Call 800-860-5260 to reach a SHICK counselor in your area. For Medicare itself, call 800-MEDICARE (800-633-4227).
constraints: Have your Medicare card and drug list ready.

name: Kansas Long-Term Care Ombudsman and adult abuse reporting
organization: Kansas Office of the State Long-Term Care Ombudsman
description: Independent advocacy for residents of nursing homes, assisted living and other adult care homes, through regional ombudsmen and the state office in Topeka.
next_step: Call the state ombudsman office at 877-662-8362 (785-296-3017), or choose a county above for its regional ombudsman. To report abuse, neglect or exploitation of an adult, call the Kansas Protection Report Center at 800-922-5330, 24 hours a day. To report abuse, neglect or poor care in a nursing home or other licensed adult care home, call the KDADS complaint hotline at 800-842-0078. In an emergency, call 911.
constraints: The ombudsman acts with the resident’s permission and is not a licensing agency.

name: Free legal help for Kansas veterans and older adults
description: Kansas Legal Services gives civil legal help across the state from offices in Dodge City, Emporia, Hays, Hutchinson, Kansas City, Manhattan, Pittsburg, Salina, Seneca, Topeka and Wichita. Its Elder Law Hotline connects Kansans 60 and older with volunteer attorneys who answer civil legal questions at no charge.
next_step: Apply online, or call the Kansas Legal Services application line at 800-723-6953 (statewide client intake: 316-267-3975). If you are 60 or older, call the Elder Law Hotline at 888-353-5337, Monday–Friday 9 a.m.–4:30 p.m.
constraints: Legal aid screens by income and case type.
The Elder Law Hotline answers civil questions only; it can also refer you to private attorneys, who charge for their services.

name: VA health care systems serving Kansas
description: Kansas veterans are served mainly by VA Wichita health care (Robert J. Dole VA Medical Center, 5500 East Kellogg Drive, Wichita; 316-685-2221), which serves 59 Kansas counties, and the VA Eastern Kansas Healthcare System (Colmery-O’Neil VA Medical Center, 2200 SW Gage Boulevard, Topeka, 785-350-3111 or 800-574-8387; and the Dwight D. Eisenhower VA Medical Center in Leavenworth). VA Kansas City health care (Kansas City VA Medical Center, Missouri; 816-861-4700) also has a clinic in Overland Park.
next_step: Use VA’s facility locator with your ZIP code to find the closest clinic. Not enrolled yet? Ask your Kansas Office of Veterans Services field office for help applying.
constraints: Which system serves you depends on where you live; VA’s locator shows the right clinic.
